plan.internalExplanationDraft: The issue concerns whether this card-not-present merchant (processing ~$42,638 net submitted card volume in September 2022 via Fiserv/First Data) is enrolled in any processor program that offsets processing costs, and what the merchant's true net cost burden is. The statement is silent on program enrollment, and no fee line items, economic categories, or contract terms are available in the packet. The transaction count is UNKNOWN. Without fee data, contract evidence, or merchant attestation, it is impossible to determine (1) whether the merchant participates in any cost-offset program, (2) whether any revenue offsets processing costs, or (3) what the net merchant-borne processing cost actually is. The reason code 'statement_silence_does_not_establish_program_use_or_absence' correctly identifies that the absence of program references on the statement cannot be treated as evidence of non-enrollment. Resolution requires either merchant attestation about program participation or the merchant contract/pricing schedule.
